output.explanation: The capture route marked the store order paid whenever the order-level status was COMPLETED, but PayPal can return that while the capture itself is PENDING (eCheck, risk review, receiving preferences) or DECLINED. The route now reads purchase_units[0].payments.captures[0].status and marks the order paid only when the capture is COMPLETED. A PENDING capture is recorded as "pending" with its capture id, so it can wait for PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED. A DECLINED or FAILED capture leaves the order unpaid. The JSON response passed back to the browser is unchanged.
output.notes: The receipt page (public/, not shown) polls GET /api/store-orders/:orderID and can now see a new status value, "pending". Check that it handles this without treating it as paid or as an error. The webhook handler still marks orders paid on PAYMENT.CAPTURE.PENDING. That is tracked as a separate finding. Until it is fixed, a pending capture that later fires the webhook will still be marked paid.
